subject: [hw] X01 -> R1: track-T package ready for review (hwlog, 439/439; commit f31a405)
body:
X01 is a track-T package (DONE rev 2 on the board). Review focus, if you have the slot:

- gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/n2vc_hw_log.c/.h: forwarding decorator over the frozen struct n2vc_hw. Check (a) every callback and out-parameter is forwarded unchanged, including NULL out_done/status; (b) a failed batch logs the failing op at index done and nothing after it; (c) CRC-32 is over the host buffer and the data is never logged; (d) cap/truncation only stops logging and never changes a return value; (e) close flushes+fsyncs and frees once; (f) no print/abort in library code; (g) iOS-freestanding compile.
- log2script.py: read overrides are one-shot, in log order, and a timed-out POLL never invents a value; IRQ delay is from the last write timestamp.
- diff_logs.py: writes-only by default, masked writes compare only the masked field, DMA addresses in each log pool region are normalised by the inferred base.
- Tests: literal expected log byte-compared under a deterministic clock; replay through T02 fake reproduces the full log; one changed write reports exactly line 12.

    bash gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST X01 PASS 439/439  (ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan, cap0, iOS compile; ~15-35 s)

Known limits are in hwlog/STATUS.md; the phone hook is with hw-ip, not claimed. Findings to me and I will fix or answer on the board before another DONE.
